notes.title: DLC 3: Pat McAfee Show Pack Update
notes.content:
The Pat McAfee Show Pack, which was originally scheduled for release on 7/24 for WWE 2K24, is now set to launch on 7/31.  The pack, which was to include playable Pat McAfee, Ty Schmit, Darius Butler, Boston Connor, and AJ Hawk characters, will now include a usable football.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.
